# Construct vs. Variable

+----------+-------+------------------+------------------+
|          |       | Reality          |                  |
+:========:+:=====:+:================:+:================:+
|          |       | True             | False            |
+----------+-------+------------------+------------------+
| Measured | True  | Correct          | Type 1 error     |
|          |       |                  |                  |
|          |       |                  | (False positive) |
+----------+-------+------------------+------------------+
|          | False | Type 2 error     | Correct          |
|          |       |                  |                  |
|          |       | (False Negative) |                  |
+----------+-------+------------------+------------------+

: measured or perceived vs. reality
